name: Relax & Rest
description: Focus on resting. Restore an additional 20% of your maximum health. While resting, you also gain +3 pool on your nightly rest — apply that at the table when it comes up.

name: Seek Inspiration
description: Gain 2 Edge Points, even beyond your usual limit — capped at 150% of your edge ceiling. Surplus carries into the next adventure.

name: Train Skill
description: Spend time learning. Choose a skill with 3 or fewer levels; gain +1 in it. Available once per character level.

name: Modify Gear
description: Install a mod into a weapon or armor. Tech d2 check; on success, open the inventory tab to attach the mod. Requires access to a workshop.

name: Repair Gear
description: Restore damaged equipment, vehicles, or drones. Tech d3 check, requires spare tech parts and a workshop. If failed, the parts and the time are wasted but it can be re-attempted.

name: Networking
description: Spend time building or strengthening connections. Choose the relevant skill and roll at difficulty 2; the outcome depends on the fiction you and the GM agree on.

name: Forge ID
description: Create a fake ID. Roll Computers or Politics — you need successes on both equal to the desired quality. Only one of the two checks per downtime; accumulate across multiple downtimes.

name: Install Cyberware
description: Install, remove, or replace one piece of cyberware in your body. Opens the Cyberware tab.
